basis: Andrew, 9 Nov 2026 (16:3x AEST): "Is all ok please fiz anything you know how everything works". T0243 (WCTV toilet block 1311144) left site 09:00 today (run 121). Its record had no on-site entry: the page held it on site only through its complete tick, from the arrival 2026-09-22T14:00:00.000Z (23 Sep 2026 AEST, the schedule's Week 4 day), and the departure was recorded against that arrival. The departure form took the tick off, so the page's departure reading now finds no arrival and counts T0243 as still to leave, although its light is in transit. That same arrival goes on T0243's history as an on-site entry, at exactly that time, with the reason. Nothing else changes. Applied only if the dry run shows the P&L unchanged and T0243 reading as left in full.

ops.why: Arrival 23 Sep 2026 (AEST) as the page held it through the complete tick when the 9 Nov departure was recorded; put on the history so the departure reading counts that departure.
